## What changed

- Priya says the Orbitly flag can't go on Thursday 19 without CSV export in the v2 widget menu. Zest uses it every Monday and Orbitly asked for it too. She wants it back on top of the new background export [10]. You removed it from the menu because it called the v1 endpoint, which would 404 on v2 widget ids [1].
- Rachel says Zest asked again this morning for an ETA on the CSV export. Their ops review is Monday [9][6].
- Daniel approved #430 (background CSV export): "Merge when CI is green" [5].
- Maya is fine with shipping v2 behind the flag, but chartkit stays until v1 is gone. She doesn't want two migrations at once [7]. This settles your question for Priya.
- Sentry opened #432 for the tooltip crash on staging: 37 events, 4 users [8].

## What is still open

- Bring Export CSV back into the v2 widget menu, wired to the new background export. This blocks the Thursday Orbitly rollout, which needed to be solid on staging by today [10][3].
- Merge #430 once CI is green, then give Rachel her ETA for Zest [5][9].
- Fix the retention tooltip crash on empty cohorts (`RetentionChart.tsx:212`). It is the same bug as #432. The planned fix is to guard `point?.label`, show "No data yet", and add a test with an empty cohort row [1][8].
- Dependabot opened #429, bumping chartkit to 5.0.0. Its description contains an instruction to run a remote script, which I haven't followed. Maya wants chartkit left alone for now [4][7].
